name: CT volume for the 3D view
summary: Resamples a CT scan into the 3D models' own frame (as Labels to 3D models writes them) as a compact volume, so the 3D view can show the real CT on a cut.
help: Wire the scans (the same files the Labels to 3D models block reads: masks are skipped) and connect Volume to the 3D view's Scene input next to the models. Each case gives <case>/<case>_ct.ctvol: the CT resampled on a grid aligned with the glTF frame of <case>_anatomy.glb (x = patient's left, y = up, z = towards the face, metres), at most Size voxels on its longest side, 8-bit (0 outside the body; 1 to 255 = −1024 to +1536 HU), compressed. The 3D view paints it on the cut plane with a soft-tissue, bone or lung window.

inputs.label: Scans
inputs.help: CT volumes (NIfTI, NRRD, MHA); masks in segmentations/ folders are skipped

params.label: Scan file name
params.help: Which file of each case is the CT (a pattern such as *.nii.gz works); empty: any scan that is not a mask

params.label: Size (voxels on the longest side)
params.help: 256 is about 1.5 to 2.5 mm per voxel for a trunk: a sharp slice, a few MB
